test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight people A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, are sitting in two rows, four in each row.

1. A is sitting in the front row, next to H.

2. F is sitting between C and B.

3. E, who is sitting in front of B, is not sitting in any corner.

4. D is sitting in the right corner of the back row.

If H is sitting in a corner, who is sitting in front of F?
solution:
Eight people - A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H.

1) D is sitting in the right corner of the back row.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1246bfb9516e8e10d2d725aa389d4cb7f74be0f703944c89d2805b915238abf.png] 

2) __E, who__ is sitting in front of B, is not sitting in any corner.

Case 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3318597c212a093b87921c77d35864c23fc827d06ba37efcfdce356fcbe0a028.png] 

Case 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b6243149c8bd82bfb697f77851e28c5963d9770a46099135082f57c011b9559.png] 

From Statement 1:

A is sitting in the front row, next to H.

It means only 2 places are vaccant than F, C and B cannot sit in front row.

From Statement 2:

F is sitting between C and B. (From statement 3 B cannot be in the corner)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7088aa2b12908128e9cad07922101d89f3f862fc82ad07268d7f48702e3ad589.png] 

After combining 2, 3 and 4;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80a1c483f14f50288fd996bea0b6732d8208e9b37d6241ab55820eb4c7218763.png] 

From Statement 1:

A is sitting in the front row, next to H.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89c5973237bb91f17fea1c4b10672f9719a9f3aed5a8210cd825687c20c90431.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7852f26201c7166d735c1c219e0311e686bae328cca5320654435c1c831f28a.png] 

**If H is sitting in a corner so here case 1 gets eliminated.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f818117db74da3171ff7ed03aa161e12c8832d2281c589904cac0e328f33cb9.png] 

From the above case:

**Thus A is sitting in front of F. **

Hence, the correct answer is **"A".**
